static_traits.name: Li Man宁
static_traits.family_status: 来自大家庭，有8个兄弟；父母年逾80岁；与家人关系亲近，但自从修屋顶事件后与一位兄长Relationship tension
static_traits.social_status: The family as a whole is fairly supportive，但来访者难以与家人讨论自己的not足与自卑感
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 态度积极、表达清晰、能Reflection与配合，能具体描述事件与情绪体验

basic_info.main_problem: 在尝试帮助兄长修房屋却弄巧成拙后，自我贴标签为“not用的手工者”，由此产生的not足感延伸到生活其他方面，影响自信与日常任务。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I really want to change the way I think about myself and feel better about my abilities.' (I want to change how I see myself and be able to view my own abilities with more confidence)
growth_experiences: 原生家庭：有8个兄弟，父母在80多岁，家庭支持性较强，但来访者表示难以与家人讨论自己的not足与自卑感（长期家庭氛围与支持特征）。
积极经历：在本次事件发生前的上个月，来访者帮助一位弟弟完成学校项目，获得对方认可并取得了好成绩，这次成功帮助他人的经历提升了来访者的Self-efficacy。

special_situations.event: While helping the older brother repair a roof leak, an operational mistake caused roof damage, further triggering the brother's disappointment and blame
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在帮助中犯错或have not做对，就证明I am useless，最好not要去帮忙
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works hard beforehand to perform well and leave a good impression; afterwards proactively offers to make amends and help again to repair the impression
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我太not用了，我not该去帮忙，我让他失望了

special_situations.event: Whenever recalling the failure of roof repair or facing tasks requiring hands-on ability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再尝试，就一定会再失败，并再次让他人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or procrastinates on tasks; before starting, worries excessively and thinks repeatedly to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我肯定又会搞砸，还是do not做了

special_situations.event: When helping cook at home, stays tense and distracted from worrying about mistakes, and ends up burning the food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果做not到完美，就等于失败，会证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively monitoring every step, attending to errors in order to avoid making mistakes, resulting in scattered attention and operational errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次一定会弄坏，我就是会搞砸

special_situations.event: While carrying out other daily tasks and chores, generalizes from one failed roof repair to ability judgments in other domains
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败意味着我在其他方面也做not好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers willingness to try, reduces taking on tasks to avoid disproving one's own ability again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain recognition and acceptance from significant others through competence and helping (especially the elder brother)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败并让他人失望，从而被negate为“without用”
defense_goal: Avoids failing again and disappointing others through self-belittlement and reduced attempts
Maintains a sense of safety and controllability in relationships through excessive self-blame and internalized criticism

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、失望的评判者（兄长）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the failed roof repair or invited in counseling to review failure details and self-feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的失望与批评内化为对自我整体价值的negate，认为“我就是without用的”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、具同理的语气，首先验证羞耻与自责感受；避免评判与急于纠正，邀请其以具体事实与情境区分“能力”与“一次结果”，鼓励识do not内在批评者的声音。

manifestations: 虽然家庭总体支持，但来访者难以与家人讨论自己的not足与自卑感
强烈渴望获得兄长的认可，当not yet被认可时体验到自我价值的孤立与动摇
outcomes: 在需要动手能力的任务中产生Withdrawal与回避倾向

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自我标签为“not用的人”
Worries excessively about disappointing others, thereby reducing attempts or self-limiting before the task begins
In narration, focuses on mistakes and failures, ignoring existing evidence of success and ability

exception_events.target_problem: 在需要帮助他人或进行动手任务时，来访者通常会Anticipation失败、产生强烈Anxiety并因此表现失常或回避。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月，来访者成功帮助弟弟完成学校项目，弟弟很满意并取得了好成绩，过程中的投入与成就感与以往“我会搞砸”的体验not同。
exception_events.reason: not同任务情境：学业项目更匹配其当下能力；not同支持：获得及时的积极反馈与认可；not同状态：Anxiety相对较低，注意力更集中。

positive_force: 家庭整体支持性较好，具有可依赖的社会支持资源
Has had successful experiences helping others (helped younger brother complete a project), has real evidence of ability
愿意求助、态度积极，愿意进行认知检验与重构
能够识do not并描述自己的负性自动思维与情绪体验，具备一定自我Reflection能力
negative_force: 自我标签化与过度概括（一次失败推及整体能力）
个人化与对他人失望高度敏感，过度背负责任
灾难化与预测失败，任务前Anxiety显著，影响注意与表现
过度Self-monitoring与自我设限，导致回避尝试与自信下滑

target_behavior.behavior: 在需要动手或帮助他人的任务前出现强烈Anxiety与消极自我对话（如“我很not用”“我会搞砸”）
antecedent: 被家人请求帮助或开始家务/烹饪等任务
回想起修屋顶失败与兄长的失望与指责
在任务进行中出现轻微差错或not确定时刻
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次显著失败后产生过度概括与个人化的认知偏差，并对被他人失望高度敏感，形成对再次失败的灾难化Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of potential failure and negative external evaluation, maintaining brief psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: 表现下降（如注意力分散、把饭烧糊）、Damaged self-confidence、Interpersonal relationships（与兄长）紧张

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬低的消极自我谈话（“I cannot do anything well”“我是not用的人”）
antecedent: 想到修屋顶事件或听到他人的not满与指责
在开始新任务或面对not熟练的家务时
target_behavior.core_reason: 以一次失败为证据进行全局negate，将他人的失望内化为对自我整体价值的评判
target_behavior.function: 通过降低期待与自我定位来避免再次遭受更强烈的外界negate与失望
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem、回避挑战、负性情绪维持与扩大
